description: This file defines a PHP interface named Deletable within the namespace Reconmap\Repositories. It specifies a contract for classes that implement deletion functionality via deleteById method.

classes.name: Deletable
classes.description: An interface that enforces implementing classes to provide a deleteById method for deleting records by ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: A method declaration that accepts an integer ID and returns a boolean indicating success or failure of the deletion.
